impact: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a security flaw impacting Broadcom VMware ESX to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, after CrowdStrike revealed that it had been weaponized by a China-nexus threat actor known as Warp Panda in attacks targeting the U.S. legal sector. Attacks mounted by Warp Panda involve the exploitation of internet-facing edge devices to obtain initial access, after which the threat actor pivots to VMware vCenter environments to deploy custom malware like BRICKSTORM and SharpStorm to maintain persistent access without attracting attention. impact: As part of the observed attacks, the hackers used the Chinese internet asset search engine FOFA to identify 19,000 internet-facing firewalls from a specific vendor, and proceeded to exploit 25 of them on October 23-24, Dream says.
